content.text: In regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving digital creators without a reliable way to monetize their work. COREMERCH provides a robust infrastructure solution that allows you to build a fully operational crypto store with no reliance on these platforms. With the right tools and setup, you can create an online store that accepts cryptocurrency payments seamlessly, paving the way for financial independence and sovereignty. This guide will walk you through the steps to deploy your crypto store using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-17|Cloudflare Workers]] Pages and NOWPayments, ensuring you can [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-github-pages-free-digital-product-20|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-7|start]] selling your digital products quickly and efficiently.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose barriers that prevent digital creators from accessing their funds or even conducting business. COREMERCH's architecture eliminates these restrictions by using decentralized payment solutions. By combining Cloudflare Pages with NOWPayments, you ensure that you maintain full control over your store and transactions. This is particularly crucial for creators in economically unstable regions where currency collapse can make conventional payment methods unreliable. By leveraging this infrastructure, you are not merely reacting to the limitations of platforms; you are proactively building a robust, self-sufficient commerce system designed for your needs.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your crypto store deployment, gather the essential components: a Cloudflare account, a GitHub account for hosting your site, and a NOWPayments account for handling transactions. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will be crucial for backend logic. Prepare your digital products, ensuring they are ready for upload. This preparation stage is vital; it allows for a smooth deployment process. By following the Sovereign Blueprint, you can expect the deployment of Stack 01 to take approximately 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 offers a more comprehensive setup within 48 hours, complete with end-to-end testing.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, first configure your NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin and Ethereum. Integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages setup using Google Apps Script to automate payment confirmation and file delivery. Next, use Cloudflare Workers to manage backend logic, allowing for dynamic responses based on payment status. This ensures products are delivered instantly once payment is confirmed, enhancing the customer experience. Testing your pipeline on mainnet is crucial before promotion; it guarantees that all components work seamlessly together. This systematic approach ensures reliability and customer satisfaction.
Full control over your store means no platform dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place and tested, it's time to go live. Promote your store by directing traffic to your GitHub Pages URL. Begin with a soft launch to monitor any issues and gather feedback. Once you feel confident, promote your store more vigorously. As customers make purchases, track transactions through your NOWPayments dashboard. This allows you to manage orders effectively and respond to customer inquiries promptly. Make sure to communicate your store's unique value proposition clearly, emphasizing the benefits of being able to transact without traditional payment barriers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Analyze sales data to identify your best-selling products and strategize on how to market them effectively. Expand your product offerings by adding more digital goods, leveraging your existing infrastructure for easy uploads and management. Engage with your customer base through newsletters or social media to keep them informed about new products and promotions. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for additional features, including advanced analytics and better delivery options, ensuring that you can continue to grow without facing the limitations posed by traditional platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by leveraging platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. These tools allow you to create a fully functional online store without the constraints of traditional payment processors. With COREMERCH, you can deploy your store quickly and efficiently, ensuring you have the infrastructure required to facilitate transactions securely.
Deploying with COREMERCH guarantees ownership of your data.

Your Deployment Checklist

Create accounts on Cloudflare and GitHub. Set up a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Prepare your digital products for upload. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for deployment. Deploy your site on Cloudflare Pages. Configure Google Apps Script for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments into your store. Test your payment and delivery pipeline on mainnet. Promote your store to attract customers. Monitor transactions and engage with your audience.

What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 deploys using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for setup. Stack 02, using Cloudflare Pages and Workers, provides a more robust environment, deployed in 48 hours with comprehensive testing and additional features.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each platform supports hosting static sites, making them ideal for selling digital products with integrated payment solutions.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies for your products, maximizing your potential customer base and transaction options.
Is there support available after deployment?
Yes, COREMERCH offers 30-day support after deployment. This ensures you have assistance as you navigate the initial stages of running your online store and processing transactions.
